errors.text_span: der linke blaue Teil repräsentiert den prognostizierten Anstieg der Ausgaben von 2021 bis 2024, der rechte grüne Teil die Ausgaben im Basisjahr 2021
errors.evidence: The blue segment is stacked on top of the green segment, not to the left. The description incorrectly describes the arrangement of the segments.
The x-axis intervals are 0.5 %, not 1 %. The description contradicts the visible scale on the image.
The description does not explicitly mention that the black line represents 1.5 % above the 2021 reference value, only that it marks a reference value.
The description omits the specific mention of Estonia and Latvia having high green segments reaching approximately 3.5 %, as highlighted in the atoms.
The description does not explicitly state that Italy, Belgium, Slovenia, Luxembourg, and Spain have green segments below 2 % of GDP.
